**Style / Genre:** Glitchcore + kawaii bass + cinematic dubstep + electronicore. Thick, growling bass layers under rapid-fire synths, sparkly kawaii bass leads, chiptune motifs, and glitchy stutters. Verses tense and digital, choruses explode with layered aggression and bright neon textures. Big halftime drops with cinematic hits, then chaotic electronicore breakdown (glitch guitars/synth-metal feel).

**Tempo / Feel:** 155 BPM (chorus feels double-time; drops hit halftime).
**Mood:** “Tune the world out” escape → self-empowerment, reclaiming control. Neon, anime-opener energy, cyber-terminal glow, broken pixels snapping into clarity.
**Vocals:** Soaring, reverb-laden lead vocal with an otherworldly sheen + occasional vocoder chops. Mostly Japanese with English lines interleaved. Kawaii ad-libs and glitchy vocal samples.

**Song Structure:**
Intro (glitch ambience) → Verse 1 → Pre → Chorus → Drop 1 → Verse 2 → Pre → Chorus → Breakdown (electronic
